messages:
Morgan: Sharing a new iteration for the Embeddings & Rerank console tab. Primary goals: clearer batch input flow, lightweight vector previews, and an export UX that avoids surprise huge downloads. Figma: https://figma.com/file/ABC-emb-rerank-v3 :mag:

Eli: Love the cleaner uploader. Two suggestions: 1) Move sample-size selector next to Start button (makes it the last decision). 2) Show a tiny estimate label: 'est. export ~12MB' that updates when sample-size/model changes.

Ana: Responsive note 12: vector-preview tooltip collides with the table header on narrow widths. Suggest switching to a bottom-anchored popover on <=720px and ensuring it is fully keyboard accessible.

Sana: Accessibility nits: focus order in the uploader modal must be linear (file -> mapping -> preview -> start). The vector inspector must have aria-labels for 'vector norm' and 'top neighbors'. Use aria-live for job progress and provide an explicit 'Stop job' button reachable by keyboard. Color contrast: pick darker accent for score bars (recommend #0B6F4A or darker).

Ravi: Backend constraints: we cap CSV uploads at 10k rows (413 returned). Exporting raw vectors for >1k rows can spike memory if done synchronously. Plan: stream gzipped NDJSON for >1k and add a progress endpoint. Will expose X-Export-Size-Estimate header.

Morgan: Good. UI decision: two export modes — 'Summary (scores + ids)' and 'Raw vectors (NDJSON gz)'. Default to summary; switch to raw through a confirm dialog that warns about size and charges. Priya, can you draft the confirm copy?

Priya: Draft copy: 'Raw vector exports can be large and may take time to generate. For jobs over 1,000 items we will compress as gzipped NDJSON. Continue with raw export?' Buttons: 'Cancel' / 'Continue and download'.

Eli: Tighten to: 'Raw vector exports may be large. For >1,000 items we provide gzipped NDJSON. Continue?' Primary: 'Download raw (gz)'. Secondary: 'Choose summary'. Add a small policy link to /docs/exports.

Sana: Also require an accessible confirm flow: focus trap, descriptive heading, and aria-describedby that explains file type and expected size. Keyboard users must be able to cancel with Esc.

DevBot: Note: deployment note 11: export streaming endpoint added to API spec. See PR #4521 for details.

Ana: Relevance table suggestion: add a tiny 'export status' chip per-row that indicates 'included / skipped / pending'. Useful when people filter only some rows.

Ravi: We'll add per-row flags in the export manifest and support chunked downloads. Implementation ETA: next sprint for streaming, 2 days for size estimate header.

Morgan: Action items: - Eli to move sample-size selector and add estimator - Ana to adjust tooltip responsive behavior - Sana to finalize a11y checklist and sample aria text - Priya to finalize confirm copy and link - Ravi to add streaming + header and document limits. Please drop screenshots and a quick keyboard walkthrough here when ready. Thanks! :thumbsup:
